authority.scope: All public N/C/O/A/U/M/V/X encodings, both P private payload forms, every typed seed form, Ed25519 versus X25519 operation separation, and the complete Operator/Account/User/delegated signer policy are normative. Current User-only production checks remain fail-closed. Rust-only M/V forms are preserved as non-NATS Ed25519 extensions. Observed incumbent type-confusion, signer-policy, secret-disposition, and resource-limit defects are explicitly non-normative.

base32.canonical_rule: Decode must consume the complete input, reject non-alphabet bytes and non-zero trailing bits, then re-encode byte-for-byte identically. Lowercase, whitespace, separators and '=' padding are noncanonical and rejected.

crc16_xmodem.scope: Every prefix byte followed by the complete payload, excluding the two checksum bytes.
crc16_xmodem.security_claim: Corruption detection only; never authentication, authorization, collision resistance or a MAC.

packing.unused_low_bits_rule: The low three bits of raw[1] are zero in canonical encodings and any non-zero value is rejected as noncanonical.

private_encoding.type_recovery: P is not self-describing by role. The surrounding owned type and the exact payload length select X25519 secret material (32 bytes) or expanded Ed25519 private material (64 bytes). An untyped P string grants no operation.
private_encoding.seed_preference: Seed forms are the canonical persistent secret for reconstructing key pairs. P is preserved for interop but must be opt-in and secret-safe.

error_contract.diagnostic_policy: Errors name class, field and safe size/type metadata. They never include seed/private bytes, full credential blocks, JWTs, signatures or decrypted payloads. Parser distinctions are stable for callers but must not expose secret-dependent timing or data.

downstream_workflows.behavior: User seed signs an 8..256-character validated server nonce and CONNECT sends nkey plus base64url-no-pad signature.
creds JWT and User seed bind by constant-time subject comparison; issuer signature, algorithm and expiration are checked before CONNECT.
caller-provided entropy creates User seeds, JSON persistence preserves generation/history/revocation, Unix files are 0600, fingerprints are domain-separated and Debug redacts seeds.
User public key becomes a durable peer identity, PeerId, fingerprint and proof identity.
active User seed signs canonical capability JSON and trusted DurablePeerIdentity verifies it.
agent credential signs a domain-separated payload with freshness and optional issuer allow-list checks.
profile manifest signature is domain separated, algorithm pinned, time/epoch bounded, trusted-key matched and revocation checked.

normative: Seed/private owned types are not Copy or ordinarily Clone.
Debug and Display redact secret material.
Serialization and plaintext export are explicit opt-in operations.
Drop zeroizes the narrowest owned buffers and documents allocator/copy no-claim boundaries.
Transient decoded buffers and authentication cancellation paths are wiped.
No error, panic, trace, log, E2E artifact or report contains seed/private bytes.
observed_incumbent: nkeys::KeyPair derives Clone and duplicates raw SecretKey and SigningKey state.
nkeys::KeyPair has no Drop zeroization or Wipe method.
IdentityKeyStore derives Clone and persists seed Strings in plaintext JSON.
PersistedIdentityKey and NatsConfig custom Debug implementations redact configured secrets.
Unix persistence is hardened to 0600; Windows ACL enforcement is external and other platforms are best-effort.

concurrency.observed_incumbent: KeyPair is Send + Sync, and public_key/seed/sign/verify use shared references without mutable internal state. Clone creates independent secret copies.
concurrency.normative: Public verification keys are Send + Sync and cheaply shareable. Secret signers may be Send + Sync only when the underlying audited primitive is; shared signing is race-free and deterministic. No mutable global state, ambient RNG or process-global authorization cache is introduced.

configured plaintext/ciphertext maximum; checked-add before allocation

observed_gaps.finding: A valid-checksum seed with unknown inner prefix 24 is accepted by Rust KeyPair::from_seed and silently becomes Operator.
Rust base KeyPairType::Curve is Ed25519 material labeled X and can sign/verify; real X25519 XKey is feature-gated off.
observed_gaps.normative_resolution: Separate owned Ed25519 and X25519 types; Curve has seal/open only.

observed_gaps.finding: KeyPairType::from_str maps every unknown name to Module rather than rejecting it.
observed_gaps.normative_resolution: Unknown names return a typed error.

observed_gaps.finding: The current Rust build exposes neither official 64-byte Ed25519 P form nor the feature-gated 32-byte X25519 P form.
observed_gaps.normative_resolution: N3/N4 preserve both forms through explicit typed import/export.

observed_gaps.finding: nkeys::KeyPair and IdentityKeyStore are Clone, seed export returns String, persisted seeds are plaintext JSON, and the incumbent has no zeroization or Wipe API.
observed_gaps.normative_resolution: Owned secret types restrict cloning/export, redact, zeroize narrow buffers and document persistence/allocator boundaries.

observed_gaps.finding: NATS JWT parsing verifies a signature directly against iss but does not authorize the Operator/Account/delegated signer chain or issuer_account scope.

observed_gaps.finding: Generic swarm and signed-profile verification accept any parseable public prefix without an explicit key-kind policy.
